(“Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy” added 5-25-2023 by 
O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023.)

result.prior_version_note: Section 98.0704 was first added by O-21647 N.S. (adopted 5-25-2023, effective 6-24-2023) and amended by O-21769 N.S. (adopted 2-27-2024, effective 3-28-2024). The documents do not describe what that amendment changed in § 98.0704. The Division began in 2004 as the 'Tenants' Right to Know Regulations' (O-19269 N.S.), but the documents do not say whether those regulations included a just-cause requirement, so whether the requirement is new is left null.
